body: READ-ONLY REVIEW: BLOCK on 5ab3a0a's claimed foreign-body-drop law. In contract.scala rejectUntrusted (lines 1046-1050), the replacement receipt is given result.receipt.cacheDecisions and result.receipt.policyDecisions; rejectProviderResult (673-680) directly copies both under the trusted authority. Thus a K-prime or malformed delegate can inject arbitrary cache/policy audit facts into the K receipt. ContractSuite's foreign-key test seeds neither and asserts neither absent. Cache failure likewise concatenates fresh.receipt cache/policy into wrapper-owned records (155-156) and preserves the combined vectors on rejection (181-210). Required probe: seed canary foreign cache + policy decisions, force authority/body rejection, assert both absent; preserve only ProviderCalls on conforming rejection, and only wrapper-owned cache decisions/denials on cache rejection. No W3 regression and no edits by me; exact request sent in msg-01M15KW3BPEYVXBED27C1PS35X.
